{{Top}}
The '''NH-7 flight control avionics package''' was a [[flight control system]] designed by [[Sublight Products Corporation|Subpro]].

It was installed on the original model of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] where it controlled the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] drive, and [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]] systems.
